justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces carry highly schematic, featureless human-like figures reduced to stick or silhouette forms with no setting, and in A these appear as a row of repeated vertical strokes along a single long horizontal element (reading as a boat with crew) which loosely echoes the repeated small figures in B. Otherwise the content differs sharply: A is one isolated linear composite motif occupying a single band, while B is a crowded, scattered multi-figure scene of dozens of animated, limb-flung, dotted-and-ornamented bodies grouped in clusters across the whole field.
